widget.name: Dock Pane
widget.description: Panel that slides in from the left, right, top or bottom of the window and shows any page content

property.caption: Position of the dock pane
property.description: Side to dock: left, right, top or bottom. Default is left.

property.caption: is dock pane visible
property.description: Shows the dock pane when true. The close button and a click on the opaque dim area set it to false. Without an attribute the dock pane is visible.

property.caption: Dim Mode
property.description: none: the page is not dimmed. transparent: the page is dimmed and can still be clicked. opaque: the page is dimmed and a click on it closes the dock pane. Default is opaque.

property.caption: size
property.description: Size of the dock pane. With Fluid true: a fraction of the window, for example 0.35. With Fluid false: pixels, for example 400. Default is 0.35.

property.caption: zIndex
property.description: CSS z-index of the dock pane, a whole number of 1 or more. Empty: no z-index is set.

property.caption: Fluid
property.description: If true, the size is a fraction of the window and the dock pane resizes with the window. Default is true.

property.caption: On click action
property.description: Action to run when the dock pane or the dim area is clicked
